blocks.text: HANGS Construction Services LLC. Invented procedures for a software demonstration.

Revenue on a fixed-price contract is recognized over time by the cost-to-cost method: percent complete is cost to date divided by estimated total cost, and earned revenue is contract value times percent complete. A contract completed before the month is reported on the completed-contracts schedule, not the WIP schedule.
WIP-2 Contract Value and Change Orders

Contract value is the original contract plus change orders signed by the owner. A change order that is pending, submitted or verbally agreed is excluded until the owner signs it; the costs of that work stay in cost to date and the estimate to complete.

Cost to date is the job cost ledger through month-end. Every cost posts to a cost code in that job's budget. A cost on a code with no budget on that job is traced to its source document and moved to the job the document names.

Each project manager revises the estimate to complete for every cost code after the month's costs are in, and dates the revision. An estimate not revised for the month is not used to recognize revenue until the project manager confirms it.

When estimated total cost exceeds contract value, the entire estimated loss is recognized in the month it becomes known. The part of the loss not yet in recognized gross profit is accrued to 2260 Accrued Losses on Contracts.

Billings to date less earned revenue is an overbilling (2250) when positive and an underbilling (1250) when negative, job by job. The monthly entry adjusts 1250 and 2250 to the schedule against 4150 Contract Revenue, Over/Under Billing Adjustment.
The Controller reviews the WIP schedule, every proposed entry and every exception. Entries are posted only after that review, by the person who posts journal entries.
Appendix A. Accounts Used in WIP Entries

checks.title: Cost Coded to the Wrong Job · WIP-3
checks.detail: SC-2622, Sumner Framing Co for $18,750.00, is booked to job S-2601 but the invoice is for job S-2610. Job S-2601 (Bellhaven Branch Library Renovation) has no budget for cost code 06-100 Rough Framing, so the line was traced to its invoice. SFC-1184 reads "Larch Hollow Site 3 flex building" and "HANGS job S-2610, cost code 06-100", total $18,750.00, stamped as entered in job cost as SC-2622. AJ-01 moves it to job S-2610 (Flex Industrial Building, Larch Hollow Site 3). Left where it is, job S-2601 looks $18,750.00 further along than it is and job S-2610 looks $18,750.00 more profitable. Total cost in GL 5100 does not change.

checks.title: Loss Contract, Full Provision · WIP-5
checks.detail: Job S-2610 is now a loss contract: estimated total cost $1,103,150.00 against contract value $1,085,000.00. Flex Industrial Building, Larch Hollow Site 3's estimate rose from $970,000.00 to $1,103,150.00 (rock excavation and a retaining wall at the access drive cut, not in the bid). Estimated gross profit fades $133,150.00, from $115,000.00 to a loss of $18,150.00. Under WIP-5 the whole loss is recognized now. At 68.09% complete, earned revenue is $738,791.42 against $751,150.00 of cost, a loss of $12,358.58 in recognized gross profit; AJ-02 accrues the other $5,791.42 to 2260 so the job carries the full $18,150.00. Before AJ-01 moved $18,750.00 of framing onto this job, it showed $600.00 of profit and no loss at all.

checks.title: Estimate to Complete Not Updated · WIP-4

Ridgecrest Veterinary Exam Room Expansion took $21,350.00 of cost in October, but every cost code's estimate to complete at October 31 equals its September 30 figure; the revision is dated September 22 with the note "Rolled forward". Carried as is, estimated total cost rises by exactly October's cost, from $190,000.00 to $211,350.00, and estimated gross profit fades $21,350.00. That is the mark of an estimate not revised, not a measured fade. Under WIP-4 the schedule recognizes no October revenue on this job until Sam Whitaker revises it: earned revenue stays at September's $133,402.11. On the carried estimate it would be $141,624.70, another $8,222.59.

checks.title: Test job S-2610 for a loss
checks.detail: Job S-2610, Flex Industrial Building, Larch Hollow Site 3, is now a loss contract: estimated total cost $1,103,150.00 against contract value $1,085,000.00, a loss of $18,150.00. In September it showed $115,000.00 of gross profit. Under WIP-5 the whole loss is recognized now; the provision is worked out with earned revenue in the next stage.

checks.title: Tie billings to the billing register and GL 4100
checks.detail: 29 pay applications and draws total $2,376,500.00 to date. October's, $349,740.00, equal GL 4100's October activity. They are the receivables ledger's invoices, invoice for invoice: INV-3398 $13,600.00, INV-3419 $142,600.00, INV-3401 $64,800.00, INV-3412 $26,740.00, INV-3405 $102,000.00.

checks.title: Work earned revenue and over and under billings, job by job
checks.detail: Earned revenue to date is $2,420,133.87 against $2,376,500.00 billed. Underbillings total $87,640.34 and overbillings $44,006.47 (WIP-6). Job S-2607 stays at September's earned revenue until its estimate is revised.

checks.title: Work job S-2610's loss provision
checks.detail: Job S-2610 is now a loss contract: estimated total cost $1,103,150.00 against contract value $1,085,000.00. Flex Industrial Building, Larch Hollow Site 3's estimate rose from $970,000.00 to $1,103,150.00 (rock excavation and a retaining wall at the access drive cut, not in the bid). Estimated gross profit fades $133,150.00, from $115,000.00 to a loss of $18,150.00. Under WIP-5 the whole loss is recognized now. At 68.09% complete, earned revenue is $738,791.42 against $751,150.00 of cost, a loss of $12,358.58 in recognized gross profit; AJ-02 accrues the other $5,791.42 to 2260 so the job carries the full $18,150.00. Before AJ-01 moved $18,750.00 of framing onto this job, it showed $600.00 of profit and no loss at all.

checks.title: Measure profit fade and gain against September
checks.detail: Job S-2593 gains $1,560.00. Job S-2601 gains $14,550.00. Job S-2604 fades $3,400.00. Job S-2607 fades $21,350.00 (not measured: estimate not revised). Job S-2610 fades $133,150.00. October contract revenue is $253,592.00; after $330,190.00 of cost and the $5,791.42 provision, October shows a gross loss of $82,389.42.

checks.title: Balance every proposed entry
checks.detail: 3 entries proposed: the job reclass, the loss provision and the over and under billing adjustment, a $96,148.00 debit to 4150. Each balances.

checks.title: Add up the open items
checks.detail: WIP schedule ready: $2,420,133.87 earned, $2,376,500.00 billed, $87,640.34 under and $44,006.47 over. 3 entries proposed, 4 exceptions for a person, 2 follow-ups. Nothing was posted.
